name: inbound.recruiter
description: Triage an inbound recruiter or hiring-manager message for the 1-hour reply SLA: real search or mass blast, in-house or agency, band, and what the reply should do.

real_search.instructions: This message is about one specific open role the sender is actively filling, not a mass template or a database-building blast

criteria.in_house_recruiter: Recruiter employed by the hiring company
criteria.hiring_manager: The person the role reports to
criteria.exec_search: Retained or contingent executive search firm

band_plausible.instructions: The role described plausibly pays $250K or more all-in

reply_action.instructions: Best next action for the candidate

criteria.book_call: Reply and book a call this week
criteria.ask_two_questions: Reply asking for band and seat shape before booking
criteria.polite_decline: Decline briefly and keep the relationship

rules.reason: mass blast; no same-hour reply needed
in-band real search -- reply within the hour

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
